# Tasks.AI

> Teach once. Automate forever. Tasks.AI turns a screen recording of how you work into a versioned, runnable playbook: it extracts the tasks, decomposes them into reusable skills and actions, and runs them on your machine as you, or in an isolated VM. Every run is sandboxed, traced step by step and reproducible.

## What it is
- A screen recording in, a versioned and runnable playbook out.
- Structure: tasks, then skills, then actions, all reusable.
- Runtime: a local agent that runs as you, or a disposable cloud microVM.
- Trace: every step of a run is logged, with no black box.
- For teams that spend hours every week on the same browser chores (reports, reconciliations, copy-paste between systems): you show Tasks.AI how you do one, once, and from then on it does it on your real accounts and tells you when it is done.
- For executives: the way your people do the work is captured, turned into a digital workforce the company owns, and governed like any other asset (who may use it, which version is live, where it runs, what it costs).

## Pages
The landing page at https://tasks.ai/ has three versions of the same message, one for each reader: a builder (https://tasks.ai/builder.html), a team lead (https://tasks.ai/team-lead.html) and an executive (https://tasks.ai/executive.html). The address https://tasks.ai/ shows one of them, and every other address on the site redirects to it.
